notes.title: Day 2 Update!
notes.content:
Hello golfers!

First off we want to thank everyone who picked up our game over our launch weekend! We appreciate your support for our game and the feedback you all have provided. We have been working to make improvements and get them to you.

The update today includes new and fixed sounds! The putter and cup for each hole now have their respective sound effects. Also we have added a vibratory countdown before the scene moves to the next hole.

We have been working on a few other different things that we have seen mentioned in the feedback as well. One of those includes some of the swing mechanics. We hope to build from where we are now to give you the best feeling swing possible. We will let you all know when the next update goes live and hopefully it will include some improvements there.

Thanks again!
